sources.supports: OpenAI's official o1-mini model documentation lists the cached-input rate as $0.55 per million tokens, alongside the recorded unchanged input and output prices. This indicates the cache field addition reflects previously omitted pricing metadata rather than a provider price change.

notes: OpenAI currently documents o1-mini cached input at $0.55 per million tokens, consistent with the 50% prompt-caching discount and its unchanged $1.10 input rate. The Internet Archive CDX and snapshot requests returned errors, so available primary-source evidence does not establish an exact historical date or directly bracket when that rate applied during the earlier period.
